svg.title: The three ledgers carry different responsibilities
svg.desc: Faithful English reading view of the three separate source panels: provider raw usage and cost; platform service Tokens; customer player Tokens. No arrows or shared balance are introduced.

g.text: The three ledgers carry different responsibilities
Raw units such as model input/output, voice, and images
The procuring party settles with providers; every actual attempt retains its actual cost
Service units agreed in the customer price list
Approved service events are charged; included quantities, BYOK, and risk deadlines are handled separately
Consumer entitlements the customer's product grants players
The customer owns player wallets, prices, and payments; the platform makes no unauthorized extra deductions
